compatibility.d65_policy_binding: requested/observed execution identity remains terminal acceptance evidence

deterministic proposal, route resolver, recipe resolver, and doctor engine regression
packed skill discovery payload regression consumed by onboarding
production fixture-corpus loader plus W1/W2 contract and behavior tests

provider quality inferred from model name
subscription status inferred from API-key shape

infrastructure-only lane without same-slice production consumer and regression
